priorityDefinitions.P0: Blocks authority, safe execution, or credible release.
priorityDefinitions.P1: Material quality or consistency gap that must be addressed in the programme.
priorityDefinitions.P2: Useful improvement that does not block the first release.

issues.title: No enforceable source-of-truth hierarchy
issues.summary: Resolved in Phase 1 with one approved authority model, reconciled entrypoints, reference certification states, and a deterministic conflict validator.

issues.title: No durable ownership and contribution model
issues.summary: The pack lacks confirmed operational, engineering, content, and channel owners with explicit decision rights.

issues.title: No stable artifact and consumer registry
issues.summary: Files and downstream consumers previously had no stable IDs, state, hashes, or migration ownership. Phase 0 creates initial registers but adoption remains unproven.

issues.title: No executable LLM task, context, receipt, and evaluation contract
issues.summary: Narrative guidance alone cannot guarantee bounded context, traceability, stop conditions, or quality evaluation for agent work.

issues.title: Figma discoverability, variables, and publication state are unresolved
issues.summary: Direct metadata verifies the recorded 149:30 Mez Systems page, but it is omitted from the top-level page listing, its reference section returned no variables, and a published Mez component library was not verified.

issues.title: Named website consumer lacks claimed integration paths
issues.summary: The current consumer branch does not contain docs/mez-design-system, src/styles/mez-tokens.css, or the named home-component paths.

issues.title: No release, migration, deprecation, or exception machinery
issues.summary: Consumers cannot reliably know which version they use, what changed, when exceptions expire, or how to migrate.

issues.title: Identity is over-dependent on gradients and discs
issues.summary: The most visible recognition devices are widely imitable AI-category conventions and do not yet form a defensible identity grammar.

issues.title: Holdco mark and product marks are not fully resolved
issues.summary: Mark construction, responsive forms, clearspace, small-size behaviour, and suite relationships require a final decision and assets.

issues.title: Typography lacks a complete cross-channel system
issues.summary: DEC-TYPE-001 approves tuned Inter for primary UI and body, Geist for display, contextual-only Instrument Serif, restricted IBM Plex Mono, and mobile revision around the split. Token migration, self-hosted Geist assets, fallbacks, localisation, email and document validation remain pending.

issues.title: Colour is not modelled as a semantic multi-mode system
issues.summary: Primitive colours exist, but semantic roles, states, themes, contrast guarantees, channel modes, and product inheritance are incomplete.

issues.title: Spacing, grid, density, and responsive rules are incomplete
issues.summary: The pack lacks a coherent responsive grid, layout primitives, density modes, content widths, and stress-tested breakpoint behaviour.

issues.title: Radius, border, elevation, and surface grammar are under-specified
issues.summary: DEC-CONTROL-001 approves the action-control slice: 12px radius, solid/outline/text hierarchy, one-pixel lift, 48px default, selective icons, dark-section inversion and mobile full-width primary. Wider surface grammar, token migration and component implementation remain pending.

issues.title: Motion is a placeholder, not a system
issues.summary: One duration and generic easing cannot govern hierarchy, choreography, loading, feedback, storytelling, or reduced-motion behaviour.

issues.title: Iconography, illustration, imagery, and art direction are missing
issues.summary: The system does not define ownable non-gradient visual languages or how photography and illustration support the brand.

issues.title: Data visualisation language is missing
issues.summary: Charts, tables, thresholds, annotation, colour use, uncertainty, and dense operating data have no brand or accessibility specification.

issues.title: Accessibility is advice rather than a release gate
issues.summary: Contrast, keyboard, focus, reduced motion, screen-reader, zoom, target-size, and content tests are not automated or tied to release status.

issues.title: Component coverage is marketing-heavy and state-light
issues.summary: The library lacks the states, anatomy, variants, composition rules, and product workflows required for serious software.

issues.title: Channel systems are examples rather than production packs
issues.summary: Ads, social, email, presentations, reports, and product surfaces lack reusable templates, constraints, QA, and golden outputs.

issues.title: Verbal identity and content patterns are incomplete
issues.summary: Voice principles exist but naming, UI language, error patterns, proof structures, channel modulation, and banned conventions need systemisation.

issues.title: Brand architecture cannot yet absorb future products
issues.summary: The current four-product model lacks rules for new products, acquisitions, endorsements, suites, partnerships, and retirement.

issues.title: Portable export is a hand-maintained mirror
issues.summary: The export can drift because its tokens, assets, and guidance are not generated and verified from one canonical package.

issues.title: Asset provenance, rights, variants, and fallbacks are incomplete
issues.summary: Assets lack a complete registry of stable IDs, source, rights, expiry, responsive variants, format policy, and fallback behaviour.

issues.title: No golden-output and adversarial evaluation suite
issues.summary: Quality cannot be measured consistently across channels, edge content, breakpoints, modes, and agent outputs.

issues.title: Responsive overflow at narrow supported widths
issues.summary: Resolved in Phase 1. All eight Canvas pages pass at 320, 360, 375, 390, 768, 920, 1280, and 1440 px with zero horizontal-overflow failures.

issues.title: No research provenance or taste-reversal intake contract
issues.summary: TR-1 through TR-4 and the valid 35-plate source review are complete. Invalid pilots, directions and homepage studies remain quarantined. Visual truth passed unanimously. DEC-MOTION-002 approved the Living Core only. Hero calibration 01 rejected the single-product composition. DEC-TYPE-001 closes typography, DEC-CONTROL-001 closes action controls and DEC-FAMILY-001 closes seven product-family and commerce behaviours. The family plate's visual execution remains explicitly unapproved. Hero 02 established a promising centred direction. Hero 03 completed review with five direction approvals and one mobile edit. The deterministic Living Core library and Deep Mineral finish are approved. DEC-PRODUCT-ARCHITECTURE-001 closes the literal five-product roster, stable IDs and assignments, including Context Engine on MZ-G12. The remaining pre-cutover work is the agent-owned migration snapshot, clean-clone proof and rollback record. Product-expression grammar, originality review and production promotion remain post-cutover work.

issues.title: No Code Connect or design-to-code parity layer
issues.summary: Figma components and production components have no explicit mapping, prop parity, version relationship, or automated drift check.

issues.title: Archive and legacy boundaries are not fully machine-readable
issues.summary: Historical studies, legacy website material, fixtures, and canonical sources need explicit classification so agents cannot promote the wrong file.
